Frequently Asked Questions

You can easily reach our support team through multiple channels. You can create a ticket directly from your account, use the "Chat with Us" button on the homepage, or send us an email. Additionally, our contact information, including our physical address, is available on the "Contact Us" page. We provide various ways to ensure you can connect with us whenever you need assistance.

Yes, Echo Trade offers a generous bonus system. When you sign up, you can benefit from additional ROI percentages and a higher trade margin P&L, enhancing your trading potential right from the start. Additionally, you can earn up to $5,000 USD through our referral program by successfully referring others who make a potential trade. This bonus structure is designed to boost your trading experience and reward you for growing our community.

You can easily check your account balance directly from the dashboard on Echo Trade. Simply log in to your account, and your balance will be displayed prominently on the dashboard. Additionally, by using the "Connect Wallet" button, you can link your Web3 wallet to have direct access to your assets. This feature provides real-time transparency and utilizes advanced Web3 security protocols to ensure that your crypto holdings are both accessible and secure at all times.

Echo Trade operates exclusively with cryptocurrency payment gateways, ensuring a seamless and secure experience for all transactions. Since all trading is conducted with currency pairs in a decentralized manner, we only accept payments via crypto. This allows for faster, more secure transactions without the need for traditional banking intermediaries, keeping your trading experience efficient and aligned with the latest in digital financial technology.

Echo Trade uses advanced algorithms and AI-driven strategies to execute trades based on current market trends automatically. Our system continuously analyzes the market in real-time, identifying profitable opportunities and executing trades with precision. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, Echo Trade ensures that your investments are managed efficiently, allowing you to benefit from market fluctuations without the need for constant monitoring. Simply set your preferences, and Echo Trade will handle the rest, optimizing your portfolio and maximizing returns with minimal effort on your part.
